source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Change different Time zone

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Make sure the date and time will change after set the Daylight saving time.

original_test_intent: Subject to engineering alignment of the copied DST Criteria, verify changing the BMC timezone/SEL UTC-offset control from an approved source zone to an approved target zone changes local representation and timezone metadata as specified while preserving the correct UTC instant and auditable event ordering.
original_method: Preserve the Master conflict; use a pinned reviewed revision of the referenced SEL UTC-offset Script and the verified WebUI control to record baseline zone/offset/DST/NTP and normalized clocks, save one approved target timezone/offset, compare UI/API/SEL metadata and local-versus-UTC values, then restore and verify the original policy without clearing logs.
manual_activity: An engineer corrects the Review-layer acceptance target, selects source/target zones and approves the policy mutation. A human operates/visually checks the WebUI. Automation may run a reviewed offset readback and normalize clocks, but cannot treat timezone and DST as interchangeable or issue the verdict.
required_inputs: Engineer decision aligning Time Zone title/procedure with corrected criteria while keeping the separate DST row distinct
BMC/firmware/WebUI identity, authorized account and documented zone/offset clock architecture
Pinned reviewed internal Script commit plus exact raw-command semantics and rollback
Approved source and target IANA zones or fixed offsets, including expected offset encoding and DST interaction
Expected UTC invariance, local display/metadata, affected clock/log surfaces, tolerance and settling
NTP/PTP policy and time-sensitive certificate/token/schedule/power/audit impact approval
Trusted UTC reference, event-boundary collection and original-zone restoration plan
safety_requirements: Do not clear SEL/audit/host logs; preserve UTC and local timestamps before and after the zone change.
Do not execute until engineering resolves the timezone-versus-DST Criteria conflict and the exact zone/offset encoding is approved.
Do not choose arbitrary zones or assume a regional IANA zone equals a fixed offset; record DST rule behavior separately.
Review the internal Script before use and verify its target, byte order/units and get/set symmetry; do not guess raw IPMI fields.
Protect credentials and avoid unrelated absolute-time, NTP or host-time changes; a timezone change should not silently move the UTC instant unless the vendor specification says so.
Stop on unexpected UTC mutation, NTP overwrite, wrong zone/offset or event-order inconsistency; restore the exact baseline without automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate the engineer criteria decision, target, zones/offset encoding, Script revision, affected surfaces, UTC/tolerance, NTP/impact and recovery before presenting the write.
Capture pre-change WebUI/API/SEL zone metadata, normalized clocks and event boundaries without clearing logs.
After human WebUI save or approved Script action, collect the audit/raw readback and compare local offset/metadata while checking UTC invariance and DST/NTP behavior.
Restore and verify the original policy, preserving coverage differences and stopping without guessed raw fields, DST substitution, retry or DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Correct the Review-layer Criteria to timezone-specific acceptance or explicitly split retained DST coverage from this row.
Approve source/target zone/offset, Script/method, UTC invariant, DST/NTP interaction and restoration/impact plan.
Review UI/raw normalized time and event evidence and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Partially fits the title/procedure but ignores the contradictory DST Criteria and referenced raw-offset Script. A generic WebUI change plus one clock read cannot prove exact zone metadata, offset encoding, UTC preservation or SEL behavior.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After engineering aligns Criteria, use the verified WebUI control and/or reviewed Project-approved SEL UTC-offset Script for one explicit zone change; corroborate with protected normalized WebUI/API/SEL reads and restore baseline.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Time Zone title/procedure, copied Daylight-saving Criteria, internal `49-50.set-get_sel-time-utc-offset.git` URL, DeepSeek WebUI/readback/risk and 5/5-minute estimates remain preserved; Review does not silently rewrite Master.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Align timezone-specific acceptance, then change one approved zone/offset through the source path, prove exact metadata/local shift plus UTC/event integrity, and restore the baseline.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The selected BMC firmware/WebUI/SEL UTC-offset implementation and Project-supported timezone model.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC/WebUI/API/IPMI versions, timezone database, NTP/PTP configuration and internal Script commit.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor timezone/SEL offset semantics, Project regional time policy, reviewed Script and recovery SOP.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Preserves the conflict while adding exact zone/offset, UTC invariant, Script validation, multi-surface evidence and restoration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Timezone offset evidence does not prove DST transitions; a WebUI change does not automatically prove raw IPMI Script behavior and vice versa; local display alone does not prove UTC/event integrity.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Criteria decision, zones/offset, Script, clock surfaces, NTP/DST, tolerance and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong offset encoding can misdate all SEL events and scheduled actions; regional zones change with rules while fixed offsets do not.

project_override_considerations: A Project may select WebUI, reviewed raw IPMI or another approved interface if the original method/Script, actual path, reason, engineer approval and uncovered coverage are recorded. Passing timezone offset cannot claim the separate DST row, and a DST toggle cannot satisfy timezone selection.
expected_evidence: Engineer criteria decision, target/version identity, reviewed Script commit, approved source/target zone or offset and UTC/DST/NTP/tolerance expectations
Pre-change UI/API/SEL zone metadata, normalized local/UTC clocks and unmodified event boundaries
WebUI save/audit or reviewed raw request/response with exact offset encoding and protected target identity
Post-change local display/metadata, UTC invariant, API/SEL timestamps, DST/NTP interaction and event-order comparison
Exact original-zone restoration, no log clear/retry, timezone-versus-DST coverage statement and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and Procedure explicitly test changing Time Zone, and the referenced Script sets/gets SEL time UTC offset, but Criteria instead requires change after setting Daylight saving time. DST is a separate preceding testcase and is not equivalent to timezone selection. Review cannot silently replace the preserved Criteria.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The timezone operation and likely intended acceptance are identifiable, and the neighboring DST row clarifies the separation. Engineering can align Review-layer Criteria and Project inputs can define exact zones/offsets, so this is decision/readiness pending rather than permanently BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on normalized timezone evidence but elevates the copied DST Criteria to a formal source conflict and engineer decision.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Replaces unflagged title/criteria mismatch with explicit ownership and a validated zone/offset evidence contract.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Keeps DST rule/transition acceptance in row 919 and prevents it from substituting for timezone selection.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No invalid draft exists for this exact source identity.

review_improvement: Prevents a timezone change from being accepted against unrelated DST Criteria and prevents an unreviewed raw-offset command or local display shift from being treated as proof of correct UTC/SEL behavior.
independent_technical_reasoning: Timezone selection and DST are related but distinct transformations. The referenced Script's UTC-offset focus aligns with the title, whereas the Criteria copies the prior DST case. A valid review must preserve and expose that conflict, require engineering to set the accepted layer, and then prove local metadata changes without corrupting the UTC instant or SEL chronology.
